note: The emphatic command 'you shall liberally give him' (הַעֲנֵיק תַּעֲנִיק) is reduced; the idea of giving generously is omitted.
Statement 'Yahweh is the one who will require' changed to jussive wish 'let the Lord himself hold us accountable'
Arabic renders 'attack me' as 'kill me,' adding lethal intent not in the source.
Hebrew 'for not returning' (ground of guilt) rendered as purpose 'lest the king return' (لئلا يرد), changing the logical relation.
Omits the imperative 'Say' (דַּבְּרוּ) introducing the proverb.
Renders 'by him' (מֵאוֹתוֹ) as 'about his way', losing inquiry through the prophet.
Hebrew 'they dwelt in their place' rendered as 'they dwelt in their land' — adds 'land' not in source.
Source has the night personified as speaker ('the night that said'); Arabic renders it passively 'in which it was said,' changing the speaker.
Source says 'come forth from the belly and perish'; Arabic negates it: 'I came out... and did not die,' reversing the meaning.
Question word changed from 'what' to 'why' in both clauses.
Final clause 'together they will be filled against me' is rendered 'they gathered against me'; 'filled' omitted.
Adds 'which he obtains' to 'for a portion'; source does not state he receives it.
Source asserts 'indeed/surely I have erred'; Arabic makes it conditional 'if I have erred'.
Omits 'calamity' (אֵיד); renders only 'the dread of God is upon me'.
Changes 'Who will give of his flesh? We are not satisfied' into 'who finds one not satisfied with his flesh'.
Statement ('He shut the sea') changed into a question ('Who shut...?').
Adds 'my words' (كلامي) as object of despising, not present in the source.
Last clause reversed: source says their form is consumed away from their dwelling; Arabic says Sheol will be their dwelling.
'Over me' (עָלַי) is replaced by 'at my victory' (بانتصاري), adding 'my victory' and losing 'over me'.
Subject/object reversed: Arabic says the waters poured out clouds, instead of clouds pouring out water.
Adds 'مرة' (once), a temporal idea not present in the source.
'ضد شرورهم' (against their evils) changes 'in their adversities' to a different idea.
'reproofs of discipline' rendered as 'disciplinary' and adds 'for the living', omitting the reproofs idea
Simile 'like a young lion' is changed to 'the cub's roar'; comparison omitted.
Predicate 'is sin' changed to coordinated 'and their sin'; adds possessive.
Omits 'formerly' (שלשום) and adds 'excellent things' (variant reading שלישים).
Adds 'safe' and changes 'all of them' to 'both'.
Comparative 'rather than' omitted; Arabic reads 'heard from the cry' instead.
First clause 'not one of these has been missing' is rendered as 'does not lack her companion', losing the 'none missing' idea.
Third clause lacks a verb: 'gauged/measured the dust of the earth in a measure' is reduced to 'and all the dust of the earth'.
Omits 'great strength' (בְּעָצְמַת מְאֹד) of your enchantments; only 'your enchantments' remains.
Subject changed: Hebrew 'he gave his grave' becomes plural 'they made his grave'.
Imperative 'return to me' turned into a question 'do you then return to me?'
Adds 'pure' (نقية) and 'flowing' (نابعًا) not in the source
Rhetorical question 'Were they ashamed...?' rendered as a statement ('they were ashamed'), reversing the sense.
Adds 'in the assembly' (في المجتمع), not in the source.
Adds 'mouth' to Babylon; source says 'for Babylon'.
Adds 'in the fire' to the Molech offering, not in source.
Omits 'you' (אַתֶּם): Arabic says only 'they and your fathers', dropping the addressees.
Person reversed: source 'I have multiplied medicines' (God speaking) becomes 'you multiplied your medicines'.
Hope of their ancestors is rendered as gathering/assembly; the idea of hope is omitted.
Renders 'not from them' as 'none of them remains', adding a 'remain' predicate not in the source.
Renders 'daub whitewash' as 'daubed with children' (بِالطِّفَالِ), adding an idea not in the source.
Pronoun reversed: 'his splendor changed' instead of 'my splendor/countenance changed' (זִיוַי).
Last clause says 'remain years far from the king of the north' instead of 'stand more years than the king of the north'.
Adds 'of the word and evangelizing with it' not in source; changes passive 'might be fully assured' to active 'I may complete'.
